| `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/specs/capabilities/device_file_transfer.md` | **Large-file transfer spec.** Flutter owns task control; data plane via Dart FTP (`ftpconnect`) or native/vendor plugins. Non-goal: GATT byte-by-byte for OTA/media. |

## 6. Transmission Methods Summary

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph ble [BLE GATT - All Glasses]
    A[Phone App] -->|0xEA/0xAB frames via Nordic UART UUIDs| B[Glasses BLE Module 中科]
  end

  subgraph wifi [Wi-Fi - AKW/BK Camera Glasses]
  B -->|0x33 WiFi commands| C[Open AP or P2P]
  C --> D{iOS vs Android}
  D -->|iOS| E[NEHotspotConfiguration AP]
  D -->|Android AKW| F[WifiP2pManager P2P]
  D -->|Android BK| G[AP mode TBD]
  E --> H[FTP album / RTSP preview]
  F --> H
  G --> I[BKSmartCameraKit TCP video]
  end

  subgraph cloud [Cloud - No Native SDK]
  A -->|WebSocket| J[ASR / App LLM]
  A -->|HTTP SSE| K[Translate]
  end
```

| Layer | Method | iOS | Android | Flutter Package |
|-------|--------|-----|---------|-----------------|
| **L1 BLE** | GATT read/write/notify | CoreBluetooth via `flutter_blue_plus` | Android BLE | `core_ble` |
| **L2 Vendor BLE** | JL/BK private GATT | `WKJLSDK`, `BKSmartCameraKit` | AAR/SDK | **defer** (`BleVendorAdapter`) |
| **L3 Commands** | `0xEA`/`0xAB` protocol frames | `BLE_WAKEUP+*.m` | `GlassesOrder.kt` | `common_glasses_protocol` |
| **Wi-Fi connect** | AP or P2P | `NEHotspotConfiguration` | `WifiP2pManager` / `WifiNetworkSpecifier` | `common_glasses_p2p` (native plugin) |
| **Video preview** | RTSP (AKW) | VLC / RTSP | Camera2 + RTSP | `FijkVisualStream` via `common_glasses_p2p` |
| **Video preview** | Private TCP (BK) | `BKSmartCameraKit` | `iot_bk_sdk.aar` | **planned** (`0013` plan) |
| **File transfer** | FTP over Wi-Fi | `IwFileSync` / FTPKit | `GlassesFileSyncMgr` | `core_device_file_transfer` (Dart `ftpconnect`) |
| **File transfer** | BLE direct | — | Audio glasses LD frames | defer |
| **ASR/LLM** | WebSocket | `WKInterpretationManager` | `AsrWebSocket.kt` | `feature_interpretation`, `feature_app_llm` (pure Dart) |
